statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58041 is a flaw in node:sqlite: the SQLTagStore returned by DatabaseSync#createTagStore() reset its cached prepared statements with sqlite3_reset() directly, bypassing the iterator invalidation that StatementSync uses, so a stale StatementSyncIterator could keep running a cached statement after it was reset and rebound with new parameters and re-execute writes. Node.js fixed it for 24.x in 24.18.1, released 2026-07-29: the July 2026 security release, https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases, lists 24.x among the affected release lines, and the 24.18.1 release notes, https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.18.1, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/af9ff0490c ('sqlite: invalidate tag store iterators on statement reset'), which carries CVE-ID: CVE-2026-58041 and is in the v24.18.1 tag and not in v24.18.0; outside tests it changes src/node_sqlite.cc. The CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-58041, lists Node.js 24 releases up to 24.18.0 as affected. The DHI nodejs-24 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from the upstream Node.js release tarball for their version. Each published nodejs-24 package holds one file, /usr/bin/node, a dynamically linked musl program that carries the Node.js JavaScript library and the C++ runtime where this code lives; the nodejs-24-dev subpackages hold C and C++ header files and two .gypi build configuration files under /usr/include/node, and the nodejs-24-doc subpackages hold the node man page and two debugger helper files, gdbinit and lldb_commands.py, with no ELF, PE or Mach-O file in either. We checked the node binary, /usr/bin/node, in every nodejs-24 package for Alpine 3.23 published by 2026-11-27, on x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 24.18.1-r0, 24.19.0-r0, 24.20.0-r0, 24.21.0-r0, 24.22.0-r0, 24.22.1-r0, 24.22.1-r1, 24.22.2-r0 and 24.22.3-r0 report v24.18.1 through v24.22.3 and carry the fix, while the earlier builds 24.13.0-r0, 24.13.1-r0, 24.14.0-r0, 24.14.1-r0, 24.15.0-r0, 24.15.0-r1, 24.16.0-r0, 24.17.0-r0 and 24.18.0-r0 report v24.13.0 through v24.18.0 and are affected. As a check, this fix is C++ code with no new string, so we read the machine code of the exported SQLTagStore methods in the node binary. The fix routes their reset through StatementSync::ResetStatement(), which increments the statement's reset generation counter that iterators check; in the binary that is an increment of the statement field at offset 0x48. In 24.18.0-r0 and every earlier build, on both architectures, SQLTagStore::Run, Iterate, Get and All contain no such increment; from 24.18.1-r0 through 24.20.0-r0 each of the four contains one before it calls sqlite3_reset(), and from 24.21.0-r0, where upstream moved the reset into a shared SQLTagStore::ResetAndBindStatement() method, that method increments it (upstream's node_sqlite.cc at v24.21.0 and v24.22.3 still calls ResetStatement() there). 24.18.1-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.
